_about: Per-plane VR cockpit data, read once per VR session by src/Flight/Hud/VrCockpits.cs and applied only while a headset (or the --xr-sim stand-in) draws the interior; a flat launch never reads it. interiorScaleFactor multiplies the cockpit1 mount's scale (PlaneBuilder.InteriorScale, 0.04 m per interior unit). eyeOffsetZ moves the seated eye in metres along the mount's own Z axis, positive aft; eyeOffsetY, optional, along its Y, positive up. The collimated reticle keeps the gunsight on the guns from either. A plane left out, or a field left out, takes 1.0 and 0.0. Each plane takes the values judged at the headset with --xr-tune, which writes them here. Fields and ranges: docs/architecture/Flight.md, src/Flight/Hud/VrCockpits.cs.
